# bemora — full reference (v1.0.0-alpha.9)

> Unified JavaScript/TypeScript API library and MCP server. One call shape: `await api.<namespace>.<method>(params)`. Auto-generated from the MCP catalog by `scripts/generate-docs.js`; do not edit by hand.

Totals: 157 providers · 548 methods · 143 keyless.

## Install & setup

```bash
npm install bemora
```

```js
import Bemora from 'bemora';

const api = new Bemora({
  weatherKey: process.env.BEMORA_WEATHER_KEY, // optional; env vars are read automatically
});

// Keyless provider — works immediately:
const iss = await api.space.issPosition();

// Keyed provider — reads BEMORA_WEATHER_KEY (or the key passed above):
const weather = await api.weather.current({ city: 'Cairo' });
```

Keys are read from constructor options (e.g. `weatherKey`), from `BEMORA_<PROVIDER>_KEY` env vars, or set later with `api.setKey(name, value)`. Keyed providers throw a coded `ConfigurationError` when the key is missing.

Every namespace is also an MCP tool: run `npx bemora-mcp` and call tool `<provider>_<method>` (e.g. `weather_current`, `space_issPosition`, `smart_weather`). Param names and types below are the tool input schemas.

## Provider reference

## weather

### aviationwx — Aviation Weather Center METAR/TAF — no key

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** weather

- `api.aviationwx.metar(station:string)` — Call aviationwx.metar({ station? }) — current METAR
    - `station` — string — ICAO code, e.g. KJFK
- `api.aviationwx.taf(station:string)` — Call aviationwx.taf({ station? }) — TAF forecast
    - `station` — string — ICAO code, e.g. KJFK

```js
await api.aviationwx.metar({});
```

### enriched — Enriched API provider

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** weather

- `api.enriched.weather(city*:string, units:string)` — Call enriched.weather method
    - `city` (required) — string
    - `units` — string
- `api.enriched.compareCities(cities*:array, units:string)` — Call enriched.compareCities method
    - `cities` (required) — array — e.g. ["Cairo","Dubai"]
    - `units` — string

```js
await api.enriched.weather({ city: '…' });
```

### metno — MET Norway location forecast — no key

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** weather

- `api.metno.forecast(lat*:number, lon*:number)` — Call metno.forecast({ lat, lon }) — compact 24h timeseries forecast
    - `lat` (required) — number
    - `lon` (required) — number

```js
await api.metno.forecast({ lat: 0, lon: 0 });
```

### nws — US National Weather Service forecasts and alerts — no key

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** weather

- `api.nws.forecast(lat*:number, lon*:number)` — Call nws.forecast({ lat, lon }) — NWS point forecast periods
    - `lat` (required) — number
    - `lon` (required) — number
- `api.nws.alerts(area:string)` — Call nws.alerts({ area }) — active alerts for a state/area code
    - `area` — string — two-letter state/area code, e.g. CA

```js
await api.nws.forecast({ lat: 0, lon: 0 });
```

### tides — NOAA tides and currents — no key

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** weather

- `api.tides.waterLevel(station:string, units:string)` — Call tides.waterLevel({ station?, units? }) — latest water level
    - `station` — string — default 8443970 (Boston)
    - `units` — string — metric or english
- `api.tides.predictions(station:string, units:string, date:string)` — Call tides.predictions({ station?, units?, date? }) — tide predictions
    - `station` — string
    - `units` — string
    - `date` — string — today or YYYYMMDD
- `api.tides.stations(—)` — Call tides.stations() — tide station list

```js
await api.tides.waterLevel({});
```

### weather — Weather API provider

- **Auth:** requires `BEMORA_WEATHER_KEY` — get one at https://openweathermap.org/api
- **Category:** weather

- `api.weather.current(city:string, units:string)` — Call weather.current method
    - `city` — string
    - `units` — string — metric or imperial
- `api.weather.forecast(city:string, units:string)` — Call weather.forecast method
    - `city` — string
    - `units` — string — metric or imperial

```js
await api.weather.current({});
```

### weatheralerts — Weatheralerts API provider

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** weather

- `api.weatheralerts.usAlerts(state:string)` — Call weatheralerts.usAlerts method
    - `state` — string — two-letter code, e.g. CA — omit for nationwide
- `api.weatheralerts.pointForecast(lat*:number, lon*:number)` — Call weatheralerts.pointForecast method
    - `lat` (required) — number
    - `lon` (required) — number

```js

```

    - `lat` (required) — number
    - `lon` (required) — number
    - `startDate` (required) — string — YYYY-MM-DD
    - `endDate` (required) — string — YYYY-MM-DD
- `api.earth.historical(lat*:number, lon*:number, startDate*:string, endDate*:string)` — Call earth.historical({ lat, lon, startDate, endDate }) — historical weather observations
    - `lat` (required) — number
    - `lon` (required) — number
    - `startDate` (required) — string — YYYY-MM-DD
    - `endDate` (required) — string — YYYY-MM-DD


    - `ids` (required) — array — one or more PMIDs

    - `query` (required) — string
    - `limit` — number
- `api.biomed.europePmc(query*:string, limit:number)` — Call biomed.europePmc({ query, limit? }) — Europe PMC article search

- **Auth:** none (keyless).

- **Category:** utility

- `api.quickchart.render(chart*:object, width:number, height:number, backgroundColor:string)` — Call quickchart.render({ chart, width?, height?, backgroundColor? }) — chart URL
    - `chart` (required) — object — chart config object or JSON string
    - `width` — number
    - `height` — number
    - `backgroundColor` — string
- `api.quickchart.bar(labels*:array, data*:array, title:string)` — Call quickchart.bar({ labels, data, title? }) — bar chart URL
    - `labels` (required) — array
    - `data` (required) — array
    - `title` — string
- `api.quickchart.line(labels*:array, data*:array, title:string)` — Call quickchart.line({ labels, data, title? }) — line chart URL
    - `labels` (required) — array
    - `data` (required) — array
    - `title` — string
- `api.quickchart.pie(labels*:array, data*:array, title:string)` — Call quickchart.pie({ labels, data, title? }) — pie chart URL
    - `labels` (required) — array
    - `data` (required) — array
    - `title` — string

```js
await api.quickchart.render({ chart: '…' });
```

    - `url` (required) — string — RSS feed URL

```js
await api.reader.article({ url: '…' });
```

### utils — Utils API provider

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** utility

- `api.utils.qr(text*:string, size:number, format:string)` — Call utils.qr method
    - `text` (required) — string
    - `size` — number
    - `format` — string — png or svg
- `api.utils.uuid(—)` — Call utils.uuid method
- `api.utils.passwordStrength(password*:string)` — Call utils.passwordStrength method
    - `password` (required) — string
- `api.utils.hash(text*:string, algorithm:string)` — Call utils.hash method
    - `text` (required) — string
    - `algorithm` — string — md5, sha1, sha256, sha512
- `api.utils.base64Encode(text*:string)` — Call utils.base64Encode method
    - `text` (required) — string
- `api.utils.base64Decode(encoded*:string)` — Call utils.base64Decode method
    - `encoded` (required) — string
- `api.utils.loremIpsum(type:string, count:number)` — Call utils.loremIpsum method
    - `type` — string — words, sentences or paragraphs
    - `count` — number
- `api.utils.emojiSearch(query:string, category:string, limit:number)` — Call utils.emojiSearch method
    - `query` — string
    - `category` — string
    - `limit` — number
- `api.utils.randomEmoji(category:string)` — Call utils.randomEmoji method
    - `category` — string
- `api.utils.hexToRgb(hex*:string)` — Call utils.hexToRgb method
    - `hex` (required) — string — e.g. FF5733
- `api.utils.rgbToHex(r*:number, g*:number, b*:number)` — Call utils.rgbToHex method
    - `r` (required) — number
    - `g` (required) — number
    - `b` (required) — number
- `api.utils.httpStatus(code*:number)` — Call utils.httpStatus method
    - `code` (required) — number — e.g. 404
- `api.utils.shorten(url*:string)` — Call utils.shorten method
    - `url` (required) — string
- `api.utils.time(timezone*:string)` — Call utils.time method
    - `timezone` (required) — string — e.g. Africa/Cairo
- `api.utils.timezones(—)` — Call utils.timezones method
- `api.utils.holidays(country*:string, year:number)` — Call utils.holidays method
    - `country` (required) — string — ISO country code
    - `year` — number
- `api.utils.quote(tag:string)` — Call utils.quote method
    - `tag` — string
- `api.utils.quotes(limit:number, tag:string)` — Call utils.quotes method
    - `limit` — number
    - `tag` — string
- `api.utils.define(word*:string)` — Call utils.define method
    - `word` (required) — string
- `api.utils.trivia(amount:number, difficulty:string, type:string)` — Call utils.trivia method
    - `amount` — number
    - `difficulty` — string — easy, medium or hard
    - `type` — string
- `api.utils.color(hex*:string)` — Call utils.color method
    - `hex` (required) — string
- `api.utils.randomNumber(min:number, max:number)` — Call utils.randomNumber method
    - `min` — number
    - `max` — number

    - `year` (required) — string — e.g. 2020

    - `type` — string — car, truck or motorcycle — default car

    - `make` (required) — string — e.g. toyota
    - `year` (required) — string — e.g. 2020

## meta

### free — Free API provider

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** meta

- `api.free.weather(lat:number, lon:number, city:string)` — Call free.weather method
    - `lat` — number
    - `lon` — number
    - `city` — string
- `api.free.wttr(city:string, format:string)` — Call free.wttr method
    - `city` — string
    - `format` — string
- `api.free.exchangeRates(base:string, symbols:array)` — Call free.exchangeRates method
    - `base` — string
    - `symbols` — array
- `api.free.binanceTicker(symbol*:string)` — Call free.binanceTicker method
    - `symbol` (required) — string — e.g. BTCUSDT
- `api.free.binanceTickers(symbols:array)` — Call free.binanceTickers method
    - `symbols` — array — e.g. ["BTCUSDT","ETHUSDT"]
- `api.free.football(league:string, season:string)` — Call free.football method
    - `league` — string — e.g. bl1
    - `season` — string — e.g. 2024

```js
await api.free.weather({});
```

### smart — Bemora's signature cross-provider auto-failover layer — never goes down because every category races multiple independent free providers with automatic fallback to stale cache

- **Auth:** none (keyless).
- **Category:** meta

- `api.smart.weather(city*:string, units:string)` — Call smart.weather({ city, units? }) — auto-failover: OpenWeatherMap (if keyed) -> wttr.in -> Open-Meteo -> stale cache
    - `city` (required) — string
    - `units` — string
- `api.smart.news(topic:string, limit:number)` — Call smart.news({ topic?, limit? }) — auto-failover: NewsAPI (if keyed) -> BBC/Al Jazeera/Google News RSS -> stale cache
    - `topic` — string
    - `limit` — number
- `api.smart.currency(base:string, symbols:array)` — Call smart.currency({ base?, symbols? }) — auto-failover: frankfurter.app -> ExchangeRate-API (if keyed) -> stale cache
    - `base` — string
    - `symbols` — array
- `api.smart.cryptoPrice(id*:string, symbol:string, currency:string)` — Call smart.cryptoPrice({ id, symbol?, currency? }) — auto-failover: CoinGecko -> Binance ticker -> stale cache
    - `id` (required) — string — CoinGecko id, e.g. bitcoin
    - `symbol` — string
    - `currency` — string
- `api.smart.ip(ip:string)` — Call smart.ip({ ip? }) — IP geolocation lookup with stale-cache safety net
    - `ip` — string
- `api.smart.translate(text*:string, from:string, to*:string)` — Call smart.translate({ text, from?, to }) — text translation with stale-cache safety net
    - `text` (required) — string
    - `from` — string
    - `to` (required) — string
- `api.smart.holidays(country*:string, year:number)` — Call smart.holidays({ country, year? }) — public holidays with stale-cache safety net
    - `country` (required) — string — ISO country code, e.g. EG
    - `year` — number
- `api.smart.weatherAggregate(city*:string)` — Call smart.weatherAggregate({ city }) — cross-checks temperature across every reachable provider and returns the average
    - `city` (required) — string

```js
await api.smart.weather({ city: '…' });
```
